## **Meta Ads Sync**

  

Nov 11, 2026

[Chiara Henry](mailto:chiara@hiddengem.media) [Makenna Moran](mailto:makenna@hiddengem.media) [Charlotte Pickering](mailto:charlotte@hiddengem.media) [Ananya Arora](mailto:ananya@hiddengem.media) [Dustin Baker](mailto:dustin@hiddengem.media) [Kristal Rocha](mailto:kristal@hiddengem.media) [Shawal Nazir](mailto:shawal@hiddengem.media) [Gillian Conley](mailto:gillian@hiddengem.media) [Alicia Morin](mailto:alicia@hiddengem.media) [Leshan Patterson](mailto:leshan@hiddengem.media) [Nicole Araya](mailto:nicole@hiddengem.media)

  

Meta campaign strategy aligned with client tiering and winter content optimization.

  

## **The Preserve client digital assets and campaign performance**

  - The Preserve video reel generated high user engagement within 30 minutes of posting.
  - The Preserve onboarding materials include cookie policies, booking site scripts, and link issue reports.

  

## **Meta ads campaign strategy and funnel architecture**

  - The meta ads strategy incorporates 3 core campaigns for discovery, lead generation, and purchase retargeting.
  - The top-of-funnel discovery campaign utilizes geo-fenced giveaway ads to drive profile visits and organic growth.
  - The middle-of-funnel campaign retargets engagers to drive landing page visits and email sign-ups using promo codes.
  - The bottom-of-funnel campaign retargets website visitors and email subscribers with conversion-focused purchase ads.
  - An optional 4th prospecting campaign targeting lookalike audiences requires advanced tracking and sufficient budget.

  

## **Conversion attribution modeling and PMS integration**

  - Hidden Gem AI connects PMS APIs with conversions API to track reservation values and purchase events.
  - Campaign attribution combines promo code redemption data from discovery campaigns with pixel purchase events from retargeting ads.
  - Resolving attribution overlap involves comparing final reservation values and promo codes against retargeting ad purchase timestamps.
  - Attribution data defaults to a 50/50 credit split when bookings match both discovery and retargeting channels.
  - Campaign attribution interfaces display overlapping booking data between discovery and retargeting channels for analysis.

  

## **Client tier classification and ad spend scaling**

  - Clients are categorized into basic and advanced tiers to determine ad optimization frequency and aggressiveness.
  - Advanced tier clients require established PMS API connections, match rates, and defined ROAS goals.
  - Scaling ad budgets follows client-defined ROAS goals, adjusting spending upwards while maintaining profitable return thresholds.
  - Seasonal expectations adjust ROAS targets downward during slow seasons to account for higher customer acquisition costs.
  - PMS access restrictions limit advanced meta ads optimization for specific clients like Bison Ridge.

  

## **Cloud Beds API Integration and Analytics**

  - Facebook click IDs reach the website but fail to transmit via the API.
  - Staff are coordinating with Cloud Beds to activate the API and enable data flow.

  

## **Ad Spend Budget Scaling and Strategy**

  - Dustin noted direct bookings are increasing, allowing budget scaling while maintaining ROAS targets.
  - Calls are necessary to determine client budget ranges because text messages lack seasonal context.
  - Master sheets will be populated with budget targets through kickoff and sales calls over time.
  - Clients achieving over 10x ROAS for extended periods are prioritized for budget discussions.

  

## **Winter Content Strategy and Asset Optimization**

  - Winter content must emphasize indoor amenities because warm-weather assets conflict with seasonal conditions.
  - Mild winter forecasts indicate November and December will lack snow, making late-autumn visuals acceptable.

  

## **Scope Management for Enterprise Client Requests**

  - The client requested promotion for specific one-off resort events outside standard performance marketing duties.
  - Gillian flagged that failing to define scope boundaries risks client dissatisfaction if services are reduced.
  - Dustin proposed manually exploring dynamic requests to evaluate white-glove service expectations before building automated systems.
  - Alicia raised concerns that low-attendance events could negatively impact perceived performance metrics.

  

## **Client Contact Structure and Account Hierarchy**

  - Lee serves as the primary day-to-day touchpoint for operational matters.
  - The web master manages technical website requirements and credentials.
  - Phil and Sean function as upper management contacts for leadership alignment.

  

## **Campaign Performance and Platform Constraints**

  - Gooseberry Lodges November performance is low due to a missing PMS API key.
  - Fireflies proposed increasing ad spend to $100 per day to improve November results.
  - Dustin noted that Black Friday ad spend will experience higher competition and lower returns.

  

## **AI Video Rendering and Follower Growth**

  - New 4K style models and automated export features produce sharp footage without AI artifacts.
  - The Preserve Instagram following increased from 35,400 to 35,700 users.

  

## **Next steps**

  - \[Alicia Morin\] Send the client email: containing the onboarding form, cookie policy, booking site script, website link issues, and privacy policy line removal update to follow up with them.
  - \[Alicia Morin\] Check the events calendar: to verify the exact timing of the Santa's brunch for the Preserve client.
  - \[Alicia Morin\] Meet with Shawal: to determine where to increase the ad spend for Fireflies to ensure strong performance through November.
  - \[Shawal Nazir\] Create the master ads sheet: for advanced meta ads clients to track the property management system, booking engine, connection status, match rate, and return on ad spend goals or budget ranges.
  - \[Shawal Nazir\] Verify tracking setup: during onboarding for new clients by checking property management system or customer relationship management connections, scraping websites with Claude, and evaluating integration compatibility.
  - \[Shawal Nazir\] Lead building the master tracking sheet: to record client setup details including PMS integration status, API connection match rates, and campaign overlap differentiation.
  - \[Leshan Patterson\] Restore the booking attribution view layout: to match the previous version in the hidden artificial intelligence tool for quick data analysis.
  - \[Leshan Patterson\] Update the booking attribution platform interface: to make viewing campaign overlap data more intuitive for users without requiring excessive clicks.
  - \[Makenna Moran\] Send additional winter content: to Aiden for optimization while removing irrelevant warm-weather media assets for the Preserve client.
  - \[Makenna Moran\] Create lead campaign ads: to reach a total of 5 or 6 options for the upcoming campaign following the next meeting.
  - \[Makenna Moran\] Meet with Aiden: to discuss winter content strategy for the preserve.
  - \[Gillian Conley\] Address scope boundaries: on the next call with Paul, Sean, and the team to clarify standard operational processes.
  - \[Dustin Baker\] Inform Paul on the upcoming call: that initial ad spend during Black Friday will experience higher competition and lower returns.

 Nov 11, 2026

## **Meta Ads Sync**

Invited [Chiara Henry](mailto:chiara@hiddengem.media) [Makenna Moran](mailto:makenna@hiddengem.media) [Charlotte Pickering](mailto:charlotte@hiddengem.media) [Ananya Arora](mailto:ananya@hiddengem.media) [Dustin Baker](mailto:dustin@hiddengem.media) [Kristal Rocha](mailto:kristal@hiddengem.media) [Shawal Nazir](mailto:shawal@hiddengem.media) [Gillian Conley](mailto:gillian@hiddengem.media) [Alicia Morin](mailto:alicia@hiddengem.media) [Leshan Patterson](mailto:leshan@hiddengem.media) [Nicole Araya](mailto:nicole@hiddengem.media)

Meeting records [Transcript](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?usp=drive_web&tab=t.a8q3jn88uhm6) 

  
  

### **Summary**

Meta campaign strategy aligned with client tiering and winter content optimization.  
  
**Meta Ads Campaign Structure**  
Dustin presented a 3-tier Meta ads strategy focusing on discovery, consideration, and conversion campaigns. Hidden Gem artificial intelligence tracks attribution across campaigns to evaluate return on ad spend.  
  
**Client Tiering and Access**  
Clients denying property management system access will transition to the basic tier. Advanced clients require active scaling and master ads sheet setup.  
  
**The Preserve Winter Content**  
The team reviewed winter content optimization and agreed to protect email deliverability. High-definition 4K footage was evaluated for upcoming promotional materials.

  
  

### **Decisions**

## **Needs Further Discussion**

  - **Policy for custom client event requests** The team actively debated whether to accommodate custom client marketing requests or establish strict process boundaries upfront without reaching a final agreement.

  

## **Aligned**

  - **Three-campaign Meta ads funnel structure** The team locked in a three-campaign Meta ads funnel approach consisting of top-of-funnel discovery, consideration, and purchase retargeting.
  - **Fifty-fifty attribution credit for booking overlaps** The team agreed to use a fifty-fifty credit split for direct bookings that overlap between discovery and retargeting campaigns.
  - **Master ads sheet for client tracking** The team established a master ads sheet to track client PMS platforms, connection status, match rates, return on ad spend goals, and budget ranges.
  - **Basic Meta ads management for restricted clients** The team decided to move clients who deny PMS access to basic Meta ads management without advanced PMS tracking.
  - **Client budget scaling and tracking criteria** The team aligned to prioritize budget increase discussions with clients maintaining over a 10x return on ad spend and track client goals in a master sheet.

  
  

### **Next steps**

  - \[Alicia Morin\] Send the client email: containing the onboarding form, cookie policy, booking site script, website link issues, and privacy policy line removal update to follow up with them.
  - \[Alicia Morin\] Check the events calendar: to verify the exact timing of the Santa's brunch for the Preserve client.
  - \[Alicia Morin\] Meet with Shawal: to determine where to increase the ad spend for Fireflies to ensure strong performance through November.
  - \[Shawal Nazir\] Create the master ads sheet: for advanced meta ads clients to track the property management system, booking engine, connection status, match rate, and return on ad spend goals or budget ranges.
  - \[Shawal Nazir\] Verify tracking setup: during onboarding for new clients by checking property management system or customer relationship management connections, scraping websites with Claude, and evaluating integration compatibility.
  - \[Shawal Nazir\] Lead building the master tracking sheet: to record client setup details including PMS integration status, API connection match rates, and campaign overlap differentiation.
  - \[Leshan Patterson\] Restore the booking attribution view layout: to match the previous version in the hidden artificial intelligence tool for quick data analysis.
  - \[Leshan Patterson\] Update the booking attribution platform interface: to make viewing campaign overlap data more intuitive for users without requiring excessive clicks.
  - \[Makenna Moran\] Send additional winter content: to Aiden for optimization while removing irrelevant warm-weather media assets for the Preserve client.
  - \[Makenna Moran\] Create lead campaign ads: to reach a total of 5 or 6 options for the upcoming campaign following the next meeting.
  - \[Makenna Moran\] Meet with Aiden: to discuss winter content strategy for the preserve.
  - \[Gillian Conley\] Address scope boundaries: on the next call with Paul, Sean, and the team to clarify standard operational processes.
  - \[Dustin Baker\] Inform Paul on the upcoming call: that initial ad spend during Black Friday will experience higher competition and lower returns.

  
  

### **Details**

**The Preserve Launch and Content Performance**: Alicia Morin announced that The Preserve officially launched and noted that onboarding forms were sent out. Alicia Morin discussed a newly posted social media reel featuring a voiceover by Dustin Baker, noting that it performed well and generated engagement by utilizing a comment prompt for a $150 credit with the keyword "Oasis". Additionally, Alicia Morin clarified with Leshan Patterson that documents sent regarding cookie policies and booking site scripts were separate from privacy policy updates.

-----

**Action Items Compilation for The Preserve**: Alicia Morin requested the document outlining broken links on The Preserve website from Makenna Moran, who promptly re-shared it in the internal chat. Alicia Morin compiled an email containing action items for The Preserve, which included completing the onboarding form, updating website cookies and booking site scripts, addressing website link issues, and verifying the removal of a specific line in their privacy policy.

-----

**Overview of Meta Ads Campaign Structure**: Dustin Baker presented a three-core-campaign structure for Meta ads designed to drive direct bookings: a top-of-funnel discovery campaign using giveaway campaigns to drive profile discovery and boost organic reach; a consideration campaign retargeting engagers to a landing page to capture email addresses; and a bottom-of-funnel purchase conversion retargeting campaign targeting website visitors. Dustin Baker noted an optional fourth prospecting campaign utilizing lookalike audiences for cold audiences if tracking infrastructure and budget permit.

-----

**Attribution Methods for Meta Ads Campaigns**: Dustin Baker explained attribution tracking for the campaigns, stating that bottom-of-funnel retargeting uses a property management system API connection with Hidden Gem (conversions API) to track purchases on a 7-day click and 1-day view window. Dustin Baker added that top-of-funnel and consideration campaigns are attributed via link-in-bio promo code usages and email matching from the landing page.

-----

**Resolving Attribution Overlap Between Campaigns**: Dustin Baker addressed the challenge of attribution overlap where a single booking might touch both top/middle funnel promo codes and bottom-of-funnel retargeting ads. Dustin Baker explained that Hidden Gem artificial intelligence uses final reservation values from property management system data to cross-reference booking values and dates—such as a $730.55 booking using the \`welcome100\` promo code on October 21st matching a retargeting ad event—allowing the team to identify overlapping bookings and apply a 50/50 credit split or remove duplicates for accurate blended return on ad spend calculations.

-----

**Client Tiering and Budget Scaling Based on Performance**: Dustin Baker distinguished between basic clients using a set-and-forget approach with $30 to $50 daily budgets, such as Oak and Ember, and advanced clients where the team actively scales Meta ads to maximize business growth, such as Glasscom and Waveframes. Dustin Baker discussed scaling budgets based on return on ad spend goals, comparing ad performance against online travel agencies like Booking.com at 18% and Expedia at 20% (which equate to a 5x return), while factoring in seasonal cost fluctuations between peak and slow seasons.

-----

**Technical Requirements and Master Ads Sheet Setup**: Dustin Baker outlined key operational requirements for advanced Meta ads clients, including setting clear expectations and return on ad spend goals during kickoff calls, and creating a master ads sheet. Ananya Arora and Dustin Baker discussed tracking client property management systems, booking engines, API connection status, match rates (EMQ), and budget ranges. Shal was assigned to lead the master ads sheet setup and technical onboarding, utilizing Claude to scrape client websites.

-----

**Review of Booking Attribution Interface and CRM Integration**: Leshan Patterson guided Dustin Baker through the Hidden Gem platform interface, demonstrating how to locate booking attribution and view campaign overlap under the campaign navigation. Ananya Arora and Gillian Conley discussed adding specific columns to the customer relationship management sheet for property management system details, Hidden Gem setup, match rates, and return on ad spend goals to serve as a centralized source of truth.

-----

**Handling Client Restrictions on Property Management System Access**: Chiara Henry raised concerns about clients like Bison Ridge and Daniel/Nature's Nook refusing to grant property management system access. Dustin Baker and Gillian Conley concluded that clients denying access should be moved to the basic tier, noting that marketing will still function but attribution data will lag. Gillian Conley and Leshan Patterson suggested workarounds, such as offering a video call to demonstrate what API keys access or sending an email template for the client to forward to their property management system provider, and adding a sharing consent question to the onboarding form.

-----

**Review of Existing Client Budgets and Account Adjustments**: Dustin Baker and Ananya Arora reviewed active client ad accounts and budgets, noting that Endless Days increased their spend to approximately $100 daily, prompting a move to the advanced tier, and Asheville River Cabins was bumped from $30 to $50 daily by Dustin Baker after achieving strong return on ad spend results over several months.

-----

**Ad Spend Scaling and Return on Ad Spend Goals**: Dustin Baker discussed increasing ad budgets for clients generating high direct bookings as long as a stable return on ad spend is maintained ([01:00:56](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.avsmguiccb0)). Gillian Conley and Dustin Baker debated the approach for gathering client budget ranges, noting that a direct conversation is preferable to a message because clients might not understand seasonal factors, such as targeting a 5x return on ad spend instead of a 10x return during the slower vacancy-filling season ([01:02:10](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.pnvcuoau7fiq)). Dustin Baker proposed prioritizing clients who have consistently achieved over a 10x return for a month or two for budget increase discussions ([01:03:18](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.kkuyes6yllvl)).

-----

**Facebook Application Programming Interface Integration for Cloud Beds**: Leshan Patterson reported that Facebook click identifiers are coming through the website, but data is not being sent to Henji because the Application Programming Interface is unavailable through the Asheville River Captain's Cloud Beds account. Leshan Patterson and Charlotte are collaborating with Cloud Beds to activate the Application Programming Interface so data can flow into Henji ([01:00:56](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.avsmguiccb0)).

-----

**Winter Content Optimization for The Preserve**: Makenna Moran presented an online guide detailing activities and experiences at The Preserve, including axe throwing, Bentley clay shooting, fly fishing, and picnic experiences ([01:04:10](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.lcaojow10rx6)). Makenna Moran highlighted the need to incorporate indoor winter amenities and remove outdated warm-weather content, such as snow-covered Bentley picnic scenes or pumpkins at the Hobbit house, with Alicia Morin confirming that Aiden can use newly sent content to optimize winter assets ([01:05:37](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.ttijf4gl3nei)) ([01:08:55](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.xt3vgiyjwvzz)). Makenna Moran also raised the question of adding digital snow to Santa's brunch images featuring horse carriages to match other winter clips, though Alicia Morin noted the need to check the early November event timing, while Dustin Baker suggested that mild winter forecasts in November and December mean non-winter footage is acceptable ([01:07:53](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.odofuwrhy29a)).

-----

**Handling One-Off Event Promotion Requests and Scope Creep**: Dustin Baker brought up a request from Sean on The Preserve team to promote specific one-off events on social media ([01:08:55](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.xt3vgiyjwvzz)). Gillian Conley expressed concern regarding scope creep and maintaining clear professional boundaries, arguing that accommodating last-minute requests without defining limits could lower client satisfaction if the team eventually has to pull back ([01:11:47](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.nf0eo0pisu3t)) ([01:15:49](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.8aziu9hbbt81)). Dustin Baker and Gillian Conley discussed whether to establish rigid operational lines immediately or test a dynamic, white-glove enterprise approach while utilizing automated systems, with Dustin Baker offering to finesse any future discussions with client leadership like Paul and Sean if the workload becomes unmanageable ([01:09:54](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.6uuyj9j4nevt)) ([01:13:48](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.sqkb4lemqm7r)).

-----

**Email List Integration and Deliverability Strategy**: Alicia Morin requested the past guest email list from the client to support event promotions ([01:19:14](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.22x34bv7kyc5)). Dustin Baker advised against requesting or utilizing the full email list immediately due to poor email deliverability rates and the risk of damaging domain reputation by sending too many emails during the slow season, recommending that the team rely on the fresh drip sequence for new subscribers until email marketing performance improves ([01:20:18](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.5fwd3bbcqq2m)). Alicia Morin and Dustin Baker agreed that they want to protect their performance metrics from being unfairly impacted by low event attendance if they only post stories rather than sending email blasts ([01:21:09](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.xoa0sbfbsqmg)).

-----

**Stakeholder Communication Hierarchy and Contact Management**: Alicia Morin detailed ongoing communication with client contacts regarding onboarding forms, cookie policies, booking site scripts, Guesty connections, website audits, and privacy policy updates ([01:23:46](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.kvfwrnuuqzvl)). Dustin Baker outlined the communication hierarchy for The Preserve, designating Lee as the primary day-to-day contact, the web master for technical website matters, Phil as the new general manager for upper management updates, and Sean as an additional stakeholder to keep in the loop ([01:22:59](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.qsrka24gtm3w)). Alicia Morin noted plans to copy Phil and Sean on emails sent to Lee and the web master ([01:24:38](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.nfgvx2femhi1)).

-----

**Gooseberry Lodges Property Management Software and Ad Spend**: Alicia Morin reported that Gooseberry Lodges experienced low performance in November. Alicia Morin explained that Gooseberry Lodges utilizes the Little Hotelier property management software, which lacks an Application Programming Interface key, preventing integration with Hidden Gem artificial intelligence for insights ([01:25:32](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.z5l83jl4xca2)). To compensate for signing clients during a historically slow period leading into competitive Black Friday advertising, Alicia Morin planned to meet with Shawal to evaluate increasing ad spend with Fireflies up to $100 per day, while Dustin Baker planned to brief Paul on expected higher cost per thousand impressions and lower initial returns ([01:26:49](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.lpthtwbig6f7)).

-----

**Content Performance and Video Analytics**: Alicia Morin shared that content performance for The Preserve is strong, noting that the "Win a Hobbit House dinner" post reached 12,000 views and a new reel posted two hours prior achieved 2,200 views and 60 comments. Dustin Baker emphasized that targeted conversion content, such as the Hobbit House reel, holds significantly more sales value than random high-view posts like 70,000 views on a casual cooking video because the former actually sells the property experience ([01:27:52](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.ciy0sxsgjfe3)).

-----

**Artificial Intelligence Video Export Tools and High-Definition Footage Evaluation**: Dustin Baker demonstrated an automated artificial intelligence video export tool that independently processes and exports clips from folder to folder, praising the time-saving capability. Dustin Baker and Alicia Morin reviewed the new 4K video footage of The Preserve, highlighting its sharp, high-definition quality and lack of artificial intelligence distortion compared to previous versions that resembled paintings or had matted tree backgrounds ([01:30:09](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Nf-776jbXwMmez7LsipGwzQ0Ft8U-dAGpe7mfNkJiu8/edit?ouid=106475412914217436338#heading=h.1k5noqrry4rs)).
